faq.question: What does Likith do?
faq.answer: Likith Naidu Anumakonda is an AI/ML Engineer and Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION (an AI product studio and technology venture). He builds AI applications, machine learning models, computer vision workflows, LLM/RAG systems, AI agents, and full-stack web software.

faq.question: What is Likith's education background?
faq.answer: Likith is currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) at PBR VITS, Kavali, Andhra Pradesh. He also successfully completed the Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Programme offered by Vishlesan i-Hub, IIT Patna (July 2025 – June 2026) as an additional AI/ML programme.

faq.question: What is Likith's internship at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: Likith is currently participating in the Vicharanashala Internship (VINS), associated with the Vicharanashala Lab for Education Design at IIT Ropar, from October 7, 2026 to December 5, 2026 (Currently Ongoing). It provides exposure to research-oriented software engineering and open-source development.

faq.question: What creative work does Likith do?
faq.answer: Alongside software and AI engineering, Likith is a Classical Pianist and Author of "Echoes of an Unsaid Goodbye".

faq.question: What is SAKRA VISION?
faq.answer: SAKRA VISION (https://www.sakra-vision.online/) is Likith Naidu Anumakonda's AI product studio and technology venture where he serves as Founder & CEO, covering AI application development, machine learning, computer vision, LLM and RAG applications, AI agents and automation, and software and web application development.

faq.question: What is RESOLVIT?
faq.answer: RESOLVIT is an AI-assisted civic issue tracking platform contributed for the GDG Solution Challenge 2026 (currently Under Evaluation). Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Leaflet, it supports citizens, NGOs, and civic authorities.

faq.question: Can Likith build AI agents and ML models?
faq.answer: Yes. Likith builds applied machine learning models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, and task-specific AI assistants in Python.

faq.question: Does Likith work with Python and Node.js web applications?
faq.answer: Yes. He builds backend services and full-stack web applications using Python (FastAPI/Flask) and Node.js (Express/Next.js) alongside React and Tailwind CSS.
